Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Manager position at Ideal Systems. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to build your brand and drive visibility in the B2B SaaS space.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites—skills that directly translate to producing sales materials, managing your websites, and running email campaigns. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to execute end-to-end marketing tasks, from technical audits to social media integration.

I am a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments, and I am eager to bring my Canva and LinkedIn skills to create consistent, on-brand content. I am comfortable working with customers to tell their stories and am ready to learn Google Ads and email marketing tools quickly.

I would love to discuss how I can contribute to Ideal Systems' growth. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Manager position at Ideal Systems. Your mission to extend CCaaS platforms to mobile workforces is impressive, and I am drawn to the opportunity to be your first dedicated marketing hire—shaping your brand from the ground up.

With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web design, I bring a blend of technical and creative skills that align with your needs. At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This experience has taught me to move from idea to execution quickly, whether it's publishing a blog post or updating a client's website. I am proficient in Canva and LinkedIn, enabling me to create and publish on-brand content efficiently.

My project mirook.com showcases my ability to handle a full marketing cycle: I designed and built the site, implemented structured data for AI search visibility, and integrated social media. I am comfortable working with customers to understand their stories and translate them into compelling use cases and testimonials. I am also eager to dive into Google Ads and email marketing, and I am confident I can master these tools quickly.

I am a self-starter who thrives in small, fast-moving teams. The hybrid setup and direct access to decision-makers at Ideal Systems are exactly what I am looking for. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am ready to contribute to your growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can help Ideal Systems shine.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
